'''Tie:''' {{legend0|#ae8bb1|50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = [[Governor of Delaware|Governor]] | before_election = [[John Carney (Delaware politician)|John Carney]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Matt Meyer]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} The '''2024 Delaware gubernatorial election''' was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the [[governor of Delaware]]. Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] governor [[John Carney (Delaware politician)|John Carney]] was [[Term limit|term-limited]] and could not seek re-election to a third term in office. Primary elections took place on September 10, 2024, in which Democratic [[New Castle County, Delaware|New Castle County]] Executive [[Matt Meyer]] and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] state representative [[Mike Ramone]] won their parties' nominations.{{Cite web |title=2024 State Primary Election Dates |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2024-state-primary-election-dates |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=www.ncsl.org |archive-date=August 17, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230817074608/https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2024-state-primary-election-dates |url-status=live }} Meyer comfortably won the election, albeit by the closest margin since [[2004 Delaware gubernatorial election|2004]]. Meyer's 56% of the vote is the lowest for the Democrats since that election, while Ramone's 44% is the highest since for Republicans. Republicans have not won a gubernatorial election in Delaware since [[1988 Delaware gubernatorial election|1988]]. {{toclimit|3}} ==Democratic primary== ===Candidates=== ====Nominee==== * [[Matt Meyer]], [[New Castle County, Delaware|New Castle County]] executive{{cite news |url=https://www.delawareonline.com/story/news/politics/2023/06/06/matt-meyer-delaware-governor-race-2024-campaign-election-politics/70290971007/ |work=[[Delaware News-Journal]] |last=Newman |first=Meredith |date=6 June 2023 |title=New Castle County Executive Matt Meyer becomes first to enter 2024 governor's race |archive-date=January 19, 2024 |access-date=June 6, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240119044958/https://www.delawareonline.com/story/news/politics/2023/06/06/matt-meyer-delaware-governor-race-2024-campaign-election-politics/70290971007/ |url-status=live }} ====Eliminated in primary==== * [[Bethany Hall-Long]], [[lieutenant governor of Delaware]]{{cite news |work=[[Delaware Online]] |access-date=12 September 2023 |url=https://www.delawareonline.com/story/news/politics/2023/09/12/lt-gov-bethany-hall-long-delaware-governor-election-2024/70825716007/ |date=12 September 2023 |last=Newman |first=Meredith |title=Lt.
